learning_outcomes.text: Know the theoretical foundations of the Finite Element Method.
Deepen knowledge from Strength of Materials.
Be able to apply FEM to engineering problems, especially in structural mechanics.
Be able to independently solve simple problems in stress analysis, dynamics, and heat conduction using commercial FEM software.
Be able to evaluate and discuss FEM results and know the possibilities and limitations of the method.
Be able to reliably apply mathematical methods to FEM problems.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of the Finite Element Method (FEM)
Deepened knowledge and application of FEM in elastostatics
Application of FEM in dynamics and heat conduction
Practical computer exercises on stress analysis, dynamics, and heat conduction using commercial software
Discussion and evaluation of models and results
assessment_rules: The assessment is a 90-minute written examination. Successful completion of the integrated practical work is required to pass the module.
